info.title: Daymark business and consent telemetry
info.description: Independent Daymark product-event transport. No OpenTelemetry SDK/OTLP/Collector. Task synchronization v1 is unchanged. Admin login is an HTML same-origin password + MFA flow; no bearer-to-admin conversion. Announcements are managed in the admin portal; no notification-center or desktop delivery API.
